functions.description: Parse base sandboxd log structure: timestamp, host, process pid, component, severity, and message body
Extract VM name from messages referencing a sandboxed VM
Extract process id referenced in sandbox message
Extract user field when present (e.g., escape attempts, unauthorized access)
Normalize severity casing and classify sandboxd action/event type based on message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/Successfully created sandbox/) ? 'sandbox_created' : message.match(/Destroying sandbox/) ? 'sandbox_destroyed' : message.match(/Failed to create sandbox/) ? 'sandbox_create_failed' : message.match(/escape attempt/) ? 'sandbox_escape_attempt' : message.match(/permission check failed/) ? 'permission_denied' : message.match(/heartbeat/) ? 'heartbeat' : message.match(/restart requested/) ? 'sandbox_restart' : message.match(/Cgroup limits applied/) ? 'cgroup_applied' : message.match(/chroot jail established/) ? 'chroot_established' : message.match(/modify sandbox root filesystem/) ? 'unauthorized_modification_attempt' : message.match(/mmap failed/) ? 'mmap_failure' : message.match(/Unable to resolve hostname/) ? 'hostname_resolution_failure' : message.match(/Repeated sandbox creation failures/) ? 'repeated_failures' : 'other'
